name: Willamette Valley CC

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 524251-525475 / y 5013652-5015644, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release willamette-valley-data, exportImage.10.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release willamette-valley-data, exportImage.11.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

world.note: OSM boundary way/146072029 bbox (586 x 1,554 m) + ~120 m scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 219 m of scenery west and east, 119 m south and north

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 10/2023; release willamette-valley-data, wvcc.scorecard.pdf), 2026-10-19. Hole sums match the printed Out/In/Total for all six tee sets; men's rating/slope from the card. Full card (women's handicaps) in scorecard_full.csv
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-19): Blue tees; card name 'Willamette Valley CC'; hole 13 green proposed from the lidar for approval; the maintenance no-play zone (holes 14-16) is not modelled; practice greens play as wrong greens; out of bounds = the OSM course boundary.
